messages:
mina: quick bring-up: onboarding hf/helixbridge-7b (converted from gemma->llama format) with static int4. Short prompts fine, but >1500 tokens we see exact-phrase repeats and occasional hallucinations. kv resume looks flaky when we prepend system messages.

mina: reproducible run on ded-2:
```bash
./bench --model helixbridge-7b --quant=static-int4 --prompts tests/long_threads.txt --max-tokens 4096 --warmup 1
```

cheng: did converter preserve zero-widths/soft-hyphens? those can shift BPE merges and move token ids around, which often lines up with boundary-aligned repeats.

alvaro: inspected mapping: several tokens in the 4600..4620 region include U+200B in upstream. Our converter kept them, so id mapping is off by +1 for a handful of merges. quick shim removing U+200B before encode reduces repeats.

sanjay: interesting. also ran `rotary-check` and found two heads with small fractional phase offsets:
```
head 5 offset=+0.0625
head 12 offset=-0.03125
```
Could be quant packing affecting low bytes, or a proj-order mismatch during conv.

cheng: priority: 1) tokenizer normalizer (fast), 2) run with `--kvmode=warm` to see residual, 3) if still bad, re-pack with per_head_scale=true and diff checksums.

alvaro: pushing small converter patch to branch `helixbridge/token-nfkc-shim` now (strip U+200B + NFKC). Running quick eval (~15m) and will post results.

mina: thanks. if converter doesn't fully fix, I'll attach deterministic LM-step checksums for projU/projV so we can bisect packing bytes.

triage-bot: Created ticket RH-2744: "helixbridge-7b int4: tokenmap zero-width offsets + kv-resume divergence + tiny rotary phase offsets" assigned eng-ml. https://redwood.example/issue/RH-2744 :white_check_mark:
